as_told.title: Project Sign Estimate of the Situation rejected by Vandenberg

plain: Project Sign was an early US Air Force study of UFO reports, based at Wright Field in Ohio in the late 1940s. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that its staff wrote a top secret report in 1949, known as the Estimate of the Situation, which concluded that UFOs were craft from other worlds. The story's title says that Hoyt Vandenberg, a top Air Force general, burned it. If true, it would mean the Air Force's own experts reached that conclusion and it was buried. A former Air Force officer, Robert Salas, also tells it, saying it was a real document seen by Edward Ruppelt, an officer who wrote a book called The Report on Unidentified Flying Objects. Salas dates it to 1948 and says Vandenberg rejected the report rather than burned it.
